source_caption_text:
Polo G gets emotional talking about Juice Wrld 🥺

Polo G and Juice WRLD shared a close friendship grounded in their shared Chicago roots and mutual respect as rising hip-hop stars. Before Juice WRLD passed away in December 2019, the two spent time hanging out, recording together, and supporting each other’s music. Polo G described Juice as a supportive, generous friend who was like a “big kid” and always eager to help up-and-coming artists.

Their bond extended beyond just making music, as Juice WRLD offered advice and encouragement to Polo G regarding his personal life. Following Juice WRLD’s tragic death, Polo G revealed that Juice’s passing deeply affected him, inspiring him to stop taking prescription pills out of respect for his friend’s memory. Musically, their connection lives on through collaborations like “Flex” on Polo G’s album *The GOAT* and “Flex Up,” alongside continued tributes from Polo G honoring Juice WRLD’s legacy.
